integrity: Proof is self-contained; finite exhaustive checks corroborate but do not replace the all-length argument. Closest primary texts were compared for implication; one older plausible text unavailable.
scientific_limitations: Only 2 by 2 matrices over finite commutative chain rings. Primitive normal form and lifting proved; no higher-dimensional or non-chain-ring classification. Older nilpotent-matrix work could contain equivalent special cases.
title: Valuation-uniform square-zero matrices over finite chain rings
